decision.advance_on_pass: shadow injection and expanded at-least-10-unseen-capture validation

policies.tile_geometry: equal-width half-open tiles covering each frozen interval; count=ceil(span/2s); never moved, dropped, or resized from signal outcomes
policies.epoch: fresh exact branch-bound upstream GLRT epoch source within 75 ms of every tile midpoint
policies.continuity: counter-authoritative V2 device time; verified contiguous application refills are not gaps
policies.tracker_reset: every tile is an independent hard tracker segment; no history or forecast crosses a tile boundary
policies.scoring_core: the complete deterministic half-open tile is scored once; there is no response-selected padding, retry, overlap, or substitution
policies.response: future odd-Qin frame CFO; no odd value affects source, tile, membership, support, reset, fit, or method choice
policies.aggregation: mean squared residual within device-sample-anchored 1s blocks, equal blocks within capture, equal capture MSE across seven captures
policies.interpretation: conditional receiver-relative apparent-CFO forecast generalization only
